categories.title: Area economy
categories.description: Labour market, wages, prices and consumer spending for the Los Angeles metro, county and city. These are the demand inputs that support a restaurant trade area, and the cost inputs that pressure it.

categories.title: Population & income
categories.description: Population, households, age, income, poverty and tenure. City and county totals bracket a trade area; they do not measure one, and no tract or radius estimate has been substituted for a parcel.

categories.title: Geography & growth capacity
categories.description: Land area, density, commute time, housing stock and permitted construction. Construction permits are the earliest public signal that a submarket is adding residents and daytime population.

categories.title: Schools & workforce
categories.description: District scale and enrollment from the California Department of Education. Attendance boundaries and campus-level performance cannot be assigned without a parcel, so those cells are blank and flagged.

categories.title: Tenant & lease
categories.description: The issuer's own disclosed results, unit counts, closure programme and capital structure. Chain-wide figures are not this restaurant, and a franchise agreement is not a lease.

categories.title: Risk register
categories.kicker: 07 / BUSINESS AS USUAL AND BLACK SWANS
categories.description: Two blocks: risks that recur in a normal year, and low-probability events that can remove the local economy. Each row names the official source, then the test that would close it.

categories.title: Taxes & transaction costs
categories.description: What a sale actually costs in this jurisdiction, and what an exchange can and cannot defer. Every rate is quoted from the statute or the administering agency, with the effective date.

categories.title: Decision pathways
categories.description: Six routes, each with the evidence that justifies it, the risk it creates, and the trigger that converts it into the next. The recommended sequence is labelled analyst judgement.

categories.title: Projection framework
categories.description: The reproducible half of a forecast: verified anchors, stated arithmetic and a stress grid. The half that cannot be honestly supplied is named rather than filled with a number.

categories.title: Flagged for review
categories.description: Every cell left blank, every conflict between sources, and every irregularity found in the repository. Nothing here blocks publication; each item blocks a specific claim.

decisions.indicator: Route 1: market the asset for sale before expiry
decisions.period: Begin 24-36 months before the earliest contractual expiry
decisions.note: Preserves optionality and forces a market test while the income is still contractual. Risks: transaction taxes (4.56% of a $6.0 million city sale in transfer taxes alone), reinvestment risk, and giving up any renewal upside. Gate: a real bid, not an appraisal.

decisions.indicator: Route 2: negotiate an early extension, then decide
decisions.note: A tenant that wants the site will price term. Ask for rent, escalators, options, expense caps and a guaranty. Risks: below-market rent locked for a decade, concessions, and a weak obligor. Gate: signed document plus credit review, not a letter of intent.

decisions.indicator: Route 3: hold to expiry and renew then
decisions.note: At expiry the landlord has no income and the tenant has no obligation, in a market where the same brand is closing about 1% of units a year. Leverage sits with the party that can wait, and that is not the landlord.

Requires a permitted use, drive-through entitlement, downtime, tenant improvements, commissions and carrying cost. A drive-through box is not a generic retail box. No feasibility study exists in this repository.

decisions.indicator: Route 5: sell through a section 1031 exchange
decisions.value: Deferral tool, not a valuation tool
decisions.note: Useful only if a suitable replacement is identified before the clock starts. The deadline is not the risk; buying badly under deadline pressure is.

Highest expected upside and the largest capital, entitlement and construction risk. Only rational if residual land value exceeds the existing-use value after full cost, which cannot be known without a parcel.

decisions.value: Dual track: prepare a sale and demand written renewal terms in the same quarter
decisions.note: Sequenced: (1) obtain the lease, estoppel and 3 years of operating statements; (2) request renewal terms in writing; (3) commission a broker opinion of value and, in parallel, an appraisal; (4) test the sale against the hold case using the owner's own tax basis; (5) sign whichever the documents support. Whichever comes first, do not let the option clock expire by default.

decisions.indicator: Triggers that convert the recommendation to a sale
decisions.note: (a) Tenant declines to extend on market terms or asks for a rent cut; (b) tenant closes this unit or the franchisee fails; (c) insurance premium or retention change makes the net rent unacceptable; (d) a verified after-tax bid exceeds the risk-adjusted hold value; (e) owner's liquidity or concentration need changes.

decisions.indicator: Triggers that convert the recommendation to a hold or renewal
decisions.note: (a) Signed 10-year extension at or above market with a creditworthy guaranty; (b) verified block-level trade-area growth, not city averages; (c) a capital event that makes replacing the income unattractive; (d) renewal terms that pass the four risk-balance tests on the risk page.

The owner's basis, debt, tax bracket, liquidity, estate plan and risk capacity are unknown and deliberately not collected. This is decision support on public data, not legal, tax or investment advice.

model.note: The risk-free rate, not a required return. A property discount rate adds a premium that must be stated as an assumption.

model.note: Value = NOI / cap rate. Pure arithmetic; no cap rate is asserted for this asset because none is published by any official source. Use it to see how much value a change in exit yield destroys.

model.note: 14.286 / 16.667 - 1 = -14.3% and 12.500 / 16.667 - 1 = -25.0%. A 100 bp move in the exit yield costs about one seventh of the value; a 200 bp move costs a quarter. Both differences are recomputed by the validator.

model.indicator: Derived: transfer taxes on a $6.0 million City of Los Angeles sale
model.note: 0.45% city base ($27,000) + 4% ULA ($240,000) + county $0.55 per $500 ($6,600). Excludes escrow, title, broker commission and tax on gain. Recomputed by the validator from the verified components.

model.indicator: Derived: present value of $1 received in 2030
model.note: 1 / (1.0488^4) = 0.8264. Discounting at the risk-free rate understates risk; it is a floor for the discount rate, not a recommendation.

model.indicator: Deliberately not published: a 2030-2035 sale price, cap rate, rent or renewal probability
model.note: No government agency publishes private-market cap rates or a parcel-level forecast. Compounding a regional trend into a price would be an artefact of the rule, not evidence. The framework above is what can be defended; the point estimate is what cannot.

scripts/build.py regenerates every page from data/evidence.json with no network access; scripts/validate.py recomputes each derived row independently and fails the build if any arithmetic disagrees or any unverified row carries a value.

review.indicator: Property identity: address, parcel number, building and land area
review.note: Critical. Every parcel-level check on this site (hazard overlay, zoning, school assignment, catchment) is blocked on this. The owner holds the deed; nothing public is collected here by design.

review.indicator: Lease: exact expiration, options, notice dates, rent, escalators, NNN allocation
review.note: Critical. The 2030-2035 range is not a document. Option notice windows are often 6-12 months before expiry and are the single most common way a landlord loses leverage by default.

review.indicator: Financials: NOI, rent roll, basis, debt, debt maturity, owner tax bracket
review.note: Critical. No valuation, after-tax comparison or hold-versus-sell number can be computed without these. None is invented.
High. A franchisee is not Jack in the Box Inc. The credit of the entity that signs determines the value of the lease.

review.indicator: Store-level performance: sales, rent coverage, arrears, renewal intent
review.note: High. Chain averages cannot substitute. A tenant estoppel certificate and 3 years of P&Ls would close it.

review.indicator: Trade area: radius or drive-time population, income and daytime employment
review.note: High. City and county totals are published above as context only. Census tract or block-group extracts were not obtained and no radius is assumed.

review.indicator: Parcel hazard overlays: fire hazard severity zone, seismic ground failure, flood zone
review.note: High. The three official tools are linked on the risk page and are free to run once an address is available. No claim is made in either direction.

review.indicator: Insurance: carrier, limits, deductibles, exclusions, rent-loss cover, premium history
review.note: High. Post-2025 wildfire repricing makes this a first-order economic variable, not an administrative one.
